findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: A couple trays raw chicken breast were observed stored above raw ground beef and pre-cooked diced chicken in the walk-in cooler. Education was provided and PIC removed the items mentioned and placed them in their appropriate storage order. Ensure that food items are stored appropriately to avoid cross contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking above the counter top on the right side of the dish machine was observed coming off the wall. In addition, a couple broken floor tiles were observed in the dish room as well. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the counter top will be re-caulked to the wall. Ensured that this area is sealed to the wall properly and the tiles replaced to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the following food contact surfaces to be soiled. 
1. The internal surface of other coffee maker was observed with an accumulation of soil.
2. The ice machine baffles was observed with an accumulation of pink and black molds.
PIC was made aware. PIC instructed employees to stop using the ice in the ice machine. The coffee maker was also cleaned and sanitized while inspector was present. The ice was discarded and PIC commenced cleaning and sanitizing the ice machine. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the ice machine baffles and the surface of the coffee makers are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sanitizer buckets were observed to be at 100ppm Quaternary ammonium at the beginning of the inspection. Discussed with PIC and the solution was remade to have it corrected to be at 400ppm. Ensure that the concentration of the sanitizer buckets are checked at a regular frequency and are remade if not at the label-recommended concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: The bottom of the two door standing cooler by the coffee station was observed to be partially detached. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that the unsealed/detached portion will be reattached to have the cooler in good repair. Ensure that equipments are maintained in a state of good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed accumulated soil on the air dock vent above the coffee station in the kitchen area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that the vent would be clean. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces are monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facility areas were observed to need repairs.
1. Broken coving left of the hand sink.
2. Nudo board at the triple sink at the dish storage area was observed in disrepair
3. The accumulation of soils above the caulking on the dish machine countertop. 
Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that the relevant repairs will be done.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: At the start of the inspection here were two sanitizer buckets tested and recorded at 0ppm QUAT. PIC changed out these buckets and utilized bleach as a sanitizer due to the QUAT container being empty and no truck deliveries until tomorrow. The bleach sanitizer buckets were tested and recorded at 200ppm chlorine with appropriate test strips available in the facility. Ensure that test strips are used regularly and that the sanitizer concentrations are changed at a frequency necessary to maintin the efficacy of the sanitizer. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is food debris observed to the left and behind the stove along the cook line. Ensure that the current accumulations of food debris are cleaned and then ensure these areas are cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
